note: A second look at embed.threads.picture-on-a-pin after Topher failed it again on 2026-09-21 (n-0328: a picture dropped while passing or failing a rule). Driven on a stamped scratch copy on 4730 (node tools/scratch.mjs new fix-0921c).

results.reasoning: A picture dropped on the rule pane - on the steps, nowhere near the box - is held above the box as a thumbnail and no tab opens on the file. Fail with a why on the rule’s open note filed the why as a reply carrying the picture (attachments/n-0328-1.png) and the draft recorded the fail. With the note addressed by the agent, a second drop on the conversation and a fail reopened the note with the reason carrying its picture (n-0328-2.png), drawn under the words in the conversation. Moving to another rule drops what was held, so a picture never lands on a rule it was not dropped on. The thread screen and the pin form still take drops as before.
